item.title: A Small Research Routine
item.description:
Research rarely begins with a perfectly formed question. Often it starts with a useful tension: a result that seems surprising, a policy whose consequences are unclear, or two papers that tell different stories.

For me, a productive routine is to write down that tension before searching for a solution. I then separate what I know from what I am assuming, trace the evidence behind each claim, and turn the remaining uncertainty into a question that can be investigated.

item.title: Research Reading Notes Template
item.description:
This short template helps turn a paper or course reading into a reviewable research note. It is a small demo for the Resources section; future entries can use this same page format for your own PDFs, slides, or datasets.

Download the PDF demo

The template prompts you to record the citation, research question, data and method, core finding, relevance, and follow-up questions.
